cases.name: Live activation: intent, accepted order and independent observation match
cases.note: Partial, Elysium side only (desk 0xb040b0e560e7103abb7f89b190a2fe0cd161fd3b, test mandate 2, runs/elysium-cases/): activation tx 0xf4a6a9e9ffc3d9be25ea1d76149dc71920156967a900efcf735caf1ec78c8da7 set ACTIVE with a WATCHER halt; ticks were refused (WATCHER_STALE) until the first watcher heartbeat; a watcher outage halted quoting again 46 s after the last heartbeat (tx 0x6fc648bea982579783723744e98192264f456078ea9694081030aa45b095be2f); owner pause went straight to PAUSED (tx 0x25e498d03824990ad6a4f0fb0f0030b7e38fe093dcc2bef7571c93b6489083fd). No exchange order: the HyperCore account is unfunded, so no order fit the balances.

cases.name: Normal fill updates inventory, reservation and fees exactly once
Healthy book: configured stay-out / join rule
Stale feed: independent watchdog attempts cancel without new ticks
cases.evidence: contracts test_staleShutdownWithoutAnyNewTick; keeper outage integration test
cases.note: Elysium testnet, desk 0xb040b0e560e7103abb7f89b190a2fe0cd161fd3b, test mandate 2, runs/elysium-cases/: keeper stopped at 22:53:51 UTC (last tick 22:53:45); the watcher's poke halted quoting (STALE_REFERENCE) at 22:54:08 with no new tick, tx 0x6efa3b09ae8fdefcd6ccccc9a36ab9f8949a2629b730ab0b1b5ebfb5ae2a1243 sent by the watcher key. No orders were resting (unfunded account), so the cancel path and the exchange-side scheduled cancel were not exercised.

offline.suite: Contracts (Foundry): lifecycle, reservations, signatures, shutdowns, vectors, fuzz
Reference quote engine, frozen vectors, policy
Keeper: local node + exchange test double, SDK signing vectors

limitations: Testnet only. Results do not establish mainnet profitability, customer demand or production reliability.
The keeper’s agent key can trade outside contract intents; the watcher detects this afterwards and cannot undo trades.
Observations and outcomes are reported off-chain and signed; signatures authenticate the reporter, not the data. Elysium’s native HyperCore precompile is not yet available.
Keeper, watcher and sampler run on the same hosted runner (GitHub Actions) and hand over every few hours with a short gap, covered by the on-chain watchdog and Hyperliquid’s scheduled cancel.
The service-fee token on Elysium is a valueless test token (tFEE); no verified USDC funding path to Elysium testnet was available.
Zero customers, partners or pilots. No independent security review. Keys are file-encrypted, not KMS-backed.
